title.zh: 元素和为目标值的子矩阵数量
title.en: Number of Submatrices That Sum to Target

desc.zh: 固定两行，把矩形化为列区间，再用前缀和的出现次数找回每个左边界。
desc.en: Fix two row boundaries, compress columns, and count earlier prefix boundaries for every rectangle.

complexity: O(m²n) expected time; O(n) auxiliary space, for m rows and n columns

concepts.name: Row-band compression
concepts.description: Fix two row boundaries to reduce rectangles to column intervals.

concepts.name: Prefix-frequency counting
concepts.description: Count earlier prefix sums before inserting the current prefix.
